steps.prompt: Create an image. Pixel art sprite sheet for a handheld game. The attached image is the existing sprite sheet of this exact character (Tho Tuong, an earth element elephant, LEGENDARY (final mythic form) stage). Draw NEW animation frames of the SAME character: identical pixel art style, palette, dark outline, proportions, body shape, colours, markings and accessories, and the same size as in the attached sheet, always facing right. Square canvas 1024x1024, flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no floor, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). NO food, NO props, NO human hands. Grid of 4 columns x 4 rows, one character per cell, centered, the whole character fully inside its cell (nothing cropped), sprites must not touch each other, feet on the same line in every cell except the mid-air frames. Row 1: (1) standing idle exactly like the first frame of the attached sheet; (2) EAT: trunk reaching down to the food; (3) EAT: trunk curling to bring it to its mouth; (4) EAT: chewing, big ears flapping. Row 2: (5) EAT: trunk spraying a happy puff of dust; (6) PLAY: trunk raised, trumpeting; (7) PLAY: a stomping dance; (8) PLAY: sitting and rolling backward. Row 3: (9) PLAY: balancing on one foot; (10) PLAY: a heavy landing shaking the ground with dust; (11) PLAY: trunk up cheering; (12) REFUSE food: trunk crossed over its mouth. Row 4: (13) PETTED: eyes closed, ears flapping slowly; (14) WAVE hello: waving its trunk; (15) SAD: trunk drooping, sitting; (16) ANGRY: ears spread wide, stomping.
